flavor: Oxidized copper plates line the walls, weeping streaks of pale green liquid onto a floor of polished obsidian. A single, heavy bronze sarcophagus sits atop a raised dais, humming with a low, rhythmic vibration.
name: The Verdigris Vestibule
reason: The room features a high-density combat encounter with a single high-health target, designed to drain resources before a boss encounter.
